request: Keyboard/mouse third-person self-spell targeting and nearby ground/corpse loot usability; multiplayer means original/native LMP, coop means campaign co-op.
behavior: While a friendly spell or belt item is selected, E explicitly targets the owned leader through existing pending_target/cast_portrait and normal authority commands. Left-click still targets the aimed ally.

E retains explicit unit/lever priority, then offers the nearest eligible visible corpse/pile within 3 metres through the ordinary approach/use/loot path. Native geometry blocks proximity selection across solid walls or large floor differences.
The reticle names E: Cast on self or E: Loot plus target name; pending spells show cast/cancel mouse hints. Existing Russian/German translations are reused with one new localized footer.

Native multiplayer corpse ownership/connection, spell training/stamina, potion holder and wand-charge validation are retained. Safe-zone, loading, focus, pointer/HUD, pause and script-block checks fence input.
The proximity query reuses the existing bounded world.units_near broadphase. Controller interaction keeps its existing exact-target behavior.

Safe-zone spell selection and already-pending rejection
Real posed native ally picked by mouse; target/selection retained

Explicit farther-body crosshair target precedes nearer loot
Rendered captured mouse look, aimed click, E actions, pointer mode and right-click cancel
